'''2011 Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 8–9 January 2011, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2011 Match Play Championship Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2011 Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 8–9 January 2011
* '''Winner:''' —
